headline: BREAKING: U.S. Reduces Middle East Embassy Staffing Amid Reported Iranian Threats
summary:
U.S. diplomatic missions across the Middle East are operating with heightened security precautions after intelligence reportedly warned of advanced Iranian plots targeting Americans overseas.

According to reporting by Axios and the Associated Press, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warned Secretary of State Marco Rubio in an October 23 memo that Iran had substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel, with lethal plots reportedly in advanced stages. The reports do not establish that an attack is imminent.

The State Department has ordered nonessential personnel and their families to leave U.S. posts in Saudi Arabia. Staffing is also being reduced at embassies in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates. Those embassies remain open under restricted operations.

Sources: Associated Press and Axios, October 24, 2026.
